description.en: The name of the data catalog.
The region where the data lake resides.
The name of the database that you want to query.
The storage path of the database. OSS, S3, and S3A are supported.
The key-value pairs of the database attributes.

description.zh:
租户的ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise create-data-lake-database --catalog-name hive --db-name default --description test --location oss://path/to/database --parameters key=example-string --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 3000 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
